definitions.explanation: Whether something is right or wrong, good or bad. Used when evaluating or debating the correctness of an action or policy.

examples.english: To question the right and wrong of something.

examples.japanese: {是非|ぜひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It is difficult to judge right from wrong.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{是非|ぜひ}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The merits of this policy were debated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{死刑|しけい}→死刑：13200_shikei⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{是非|ぜひ}をめぐって⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かれている→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧。
examples.english: Opinions are divided over the right and wrong of the death penalty system.

notes:
{是非|ぜひ} as a noun means "right and wrong" or "merits and demerits."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {是非|ぜひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}う→問う：02299_tou⟧ (to question the rightness of)
- {是非|ぜひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧ (to judge right and wrong)
- {是非|ぜひ}をめぐって (regarding the merits of)

USAGE:
- This is the noun usage. The adverb {是非|ぜひ} (by all means, definitely) is a separate word with a different function.
- {是|ぜ} means "right/correct" and ⟦{非|ひ}→非：28419_hi⟧ means "wrong/incorrect"
